title: The Face Trader
text: A trader in the Faceless City sits behind a stall hung with faces, rows of them pegged up like washing, some still blinking. She deals in faces, she says, and business is brisk. She will pay well for one that has already been Changed.

options.label: One who was Changed bargains with her.

outcomes.text: She pays well for a long look at their face, touches it, and gives it back.

options.label: The craftiest sells her someone else's face.

outcomes.text: Someone else's face, peeled from somewhere. She never notices.
She takes yours instead, for a while, and pegs it up with the others.

options.label: Keep your faces, and walk on.

outcomes.text: She laughs behind her hand, and for a day the Leader keeps hearing her laugh come out of their own mouth.
